'''2001 Origins Constructed (6 July)''' was a Star Wars CCG constructed (convention side event) held in Origins, Columbus, Ohio on 6 July 2001. [[Richard Haman]] won it. It is known from Ted Panczyszyn's tournament report.<ref name="tr-d2602">[https://www.stephenskilton.com/decktech_archives/reports/2001-07-09-origins-2001-weekend-report-part-1d2602/ origins-2001-weekend-report-part-1], DeckTech (Ted "Rogue15" Panczyszyn, 9 July 2001). Preservation copy: [https://stevetotheizz0.github.io/decktech_archives/reports/2001-07-09-origins-2001-weekend-report-part-1d2602/ GitHub Pages].</ref> It was played alongside the [[2001 Origins Open]].

* '''Date:''' 6 July 2001
* '''Site:''' Origins, Columbus, Ohio
* '''Format:''' [[Premiere - Tatooine]]
* '''Players:''' 18
* '''Winner:''' [[Richard Haman]]
